highlights.title: Fix Tidepool dose upload failures
changes: Dose uploads to Tidepool now succeed instead of failing with a configuration error.
Previously missing insulin entries are now uploaded and visible in Tidepool Web.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix Tidepool dose uploads failing with "configuration"
includedPullRequests.body: Fixes #1734 ## Problem On `dev`, with Tidepool connected, every dose upload fails with `Tidepool upload of N dose entries failed: configuration`. Carbs, glucose, settings and pump events still upload. Doses are only retried for 24 hours, so insulin that keeps failing is eventually not backfilled. `TidepoolService.uploadDoseData` annotates doses first, and `annotateDoses` throws `TidepoolServiceError.configuration` when `remoteDataServiceDelegate` is nil. Trio never sets that delegate. ## Change `BaseTidepoolManager` now conforms to `RemoteDataServiceDelegate` and sets itself as the delegate in the `tidepoolService` property's `didSet`, so every created or restored service gets it. - `getBasalHistory` returns `[]` on purpose. With a non-empty history, `DoseEntry.annotated(with:)` hits a `preconditionFailure` for temp basals with `unit == .units`, which is how Trio builds them. An empty history leaves each dose as Trio built it. - `automationHistory` returns one period covering the requested range, using the current dosing mode. Trio sets `automatic` on every dose, and the overlay skips doses that already have it. - `fetchDeviceLogs` returns `[]`. Upload-only: nothing here changes how Trio doses insulin. ## Testing - Added unit tests (`Tidepool dose annotation Tests`): an empty basal history leaves a Trio temp basal untouched, the explicit `automatic` flag is preserved, and a single automation period doesn't split a dose. All 38 tests in the 4 Tidepool suites pass on this branch. - Verified on a real device on `dev` 1.0.2.58 (TidepoolService `9cee9e1`) with only this change applied. Before the change every upload logged `failed: configuration` with a 218-entry backlog. After installing the branch, `Uploaded 218 dose entries to Tidepool` followed immediately, then `Uploaded 1 dose entries` for a new dose. The doses show in Tidepool Web's Daily view. - Also verified earlier on a fork build of `dev` 1.0.2.55 (TidepoolService `54097855`). ## Screenshots - Tidepool Data Platform - Trio The bug reproduces on `dev` 1.0.2.58 with #1719 applied (details in #1734). --- The root-cause analysis and fix were worked out with Claude Code. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
